newsitem.title: UK: Securicor opens 8 mln stg warehouse.
newsitem.headline: Securicor opens 8 mln stg warehouse.

text.p: Securicor Distribution said a new eight million stg warehouse will be formally opened today at Huntingdon, north of London.
The 125,000 sq ft warehouse will create 300 new jobs and is part of the company's 50 million stg investment programme for 1997, it added in a statement.
Securicor Distribution is the international logistics and distribution business of the Securicor Group Plc and has a turnover of 470 million stg.

The company also plans to open a new 30 million stg 'superhub' parcel-handling facility at Hatfield in Hertfordshire in September 1997 and will also invest 12.5 million stg in the expansion of its overnight parcels carrier branches.
